name: Force-Empowered Casting
description:
_**Consular:** 2nd, 9th, and 17th level_
You gain the ability to twist your powers to suit your needs. When you cast a force power, you can expend additional force points to modify the power. You gain two of the following Force-Empowered Casting options of your choice, located at the end of the class description. You gain another one at 9th and 17th level.
You can use only one Force-Empowered Casting option on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.
